label: Deal Review & Coaching
description: Analyse sales opportunities, assess deal health, identify risks and gaps, and get coaching on strategy, messaging, and next steps. Applies proven sales methodologies to improve win rates.

guidedInputs.label: Deal value (approximate)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., EUR 150,000 annual contract, EUR 500k project

guidedInputs.label: Buyer information
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Nordic bank, 2,000 employees, MLRO is the champion, CFO is economic buyer, procurement involved. They are currently using a competitor for AML advisory.

guidedInputs.label: What are we selling?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AML gap analysis + remediation programme, 6-month engagement, team of 3 consultants, includes policy rewrite and training

guidedInputs.label: Competitive situation
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Competing against Deloitte and a local boutique firm. Deloitte has existing relationship but client finds them expensive and slow.

guidedInputs.label: What are you worried about?
